# BI reference corpus

This directory contains test-only BI keys,
signatures produced by the original DayZ and Arma utilities,
a small PBO generated by DayZ FileBank,
and records of the corresponding runs.
The private keys are disposable test keys
and must never be used for production signing.

`manifest.json` records file hashes, signature versions,
independently recovered SHA-1 values, executable identities,
and checker outcomes.

The DayZ checker accepted DayZ V2/V3 and the Arma V2 signature.
The Arma checker accepted Arma V3.
Its V2 checker run exited with status 1 after a `deprecated` warning;
that observed result is recorded
without treating the signature as accepted by that checker.

Provenance paths are relative to this directory.
Utility identity is recorded by executable name and SHA-256.
